section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews conceptual developments in positive body image, focusing on body appreciation and body image flexibility and their relations to disordered eating, self-compassion, intuitive eating, and BMI. It states that the present investigation examines body image flexibility in relation to body appreciation and BMI in Black older adolescent females preparing to matriculate to university and does not label multiple studies or experiments.
